name: openhands

spawn.doc: One-shot OpenHands SDK worker (tools/openhands_run.py). <model> is a LiteLLM id; the runner python must have openhands-sdk + openhands-tools installed (OH_PYTHON, default: ~/.venvs/openhands/bin/python). The prompt arrives via OH_PROMPT_FILE. For non-Anthropic providers pass OH_BASE_URL in the environment (e.g. an OpenAI-compatible gateway) and use the openai/<model> id shape.
spawn.model_flag: <model> is the LiteLLM id passed to OH_MODEL

list_models_note: OpenHands uses any LiteLLM-supported provider: write the ids your provider keys can serve to .pmos/available-models.txt in the '- <id>' shape (e.g. 'openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731', 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929').

usage.doc: the runner emits usage.input_tokens / usage.output_tokens in its JSON result; host.py parses it like the claude result

file_scope_hooks.doc: The SDK supports hooks (docs.openhands.dev/sdk/guides/hooks) but per-worker PreToolUse-style file-scope denial is not wired yet; rely on trace.py unplanned at checkpoints.
